name: instruction-following-eval
scope: Exact noneditable VCS payload used by Inspect IFEval with trusted pinned benchmark instruction metadata and bounded model responses; not an internet-facing arbitrary-input service or a general NLTK security attestation.
source_payload_hash_algorithm: sha256(JSON UTF-8 source_files array, sorted object keys, separators comma/colon)

findings.resolution: Context review: random selections generate benchmark instruction defaults/keywords, not secrets, authorization tokens or cryptographic material. No cryptographic suitability claim; reproducibility still requires explicit benchmark arguments/seeds.
Context review: assertions check response string type, not an authorization boundary. Supported caller supplies strings; optimized Python is not relied upon for hostile-input validation.

checks.name: installed-payload-binding
checks.detail: All six installed package payload files, including data/input_data.jsonl, equal tracked source bytes; direct_url is noneditable and names exact commit.

checks.name: manual-runtime-and-build-review
checks.detail: Read runtime modules and declarative setuptools build configuration; AST call inventory covers all Python runtime and test files. No eval/exec/subprocess or dynamic code import from response strings found. Dataset JSON and word/language constants are data.

checks.name: OSV-commit-query
checks.limitation: Empty response does not establish repository/commit indexing coverage or absence of vulnerabilities.

checks.name: upstream-published-advisories
checks.observed_text: There aren't any published security advisories
checks.limitation: Public maintainer advisories only; not a complete vulnerability database or independent audit.

limitations: pip-audit cannot audit this VCS distribution as a PyPI release. Preserve its raw skip reason; this source review is separate evidence, never a clean PyPI audit result. Other dependency audit failures remain fatal.

NLTK helper downloads punkt and punkt_tab into ~/.cache/nltk_data when absent, including through inspect_evals. These external resource bytes are not pinned by this VCS receipt. Preprovision/review resources separately for offline or reproducible studies; this review does not attest their integrity.

The source names english.pickle, but locked NLTK3.10.3 redirects that hardcoded path to pickle-free PunktTokenizer before opening it. A bounded monkeypatched check verifies this control flow only; it does not validate every NLTK parser/resource or later NLTK versions.

Several regex patterns incorporate benchmark kwargs without escaping. Instruction metadata is trusted pinned input, not model output; arbitrary user-controlled metadata is outside this review. Responses are treated as text/JSON, but the evaluator has no intrinsic CPU/memory/response-length limit. Callers must bound responses and isolate hostile workloads.
Language detection errors log response text and return true in three checkers. Do not treat benchmark responses/logs as secret-safe or these quality scores as authorization decisions.

Build uses declarative setuptools.build_meta with unbounded upstream setuptools>=61 and wheel requirements. No custom setup.py/backend code is present; build-tool and transitive dependency advisories are separate release gates.

Bandit is a heuristic scan, not proof of exploit absence. No full fuzzing, proof of regex complexity, upstream functional test suite, live model scoring or NLTK downloads were performed for this review.
Changing repository, commit, installed payload, NLTK version or accepted input scope invalidates this review. Expiry is 30 days from review date.
